description: The project's own server, if it has one: its state, size, memory, what the project reserves on it, the last step of its creation, the operation working on it, why its last create, delete, sleep or wake failed, and refusals: the error code a sleep or a wake would answer now, or null when an owner may ask it. server is null for a project with no server. sizes are the ones its organization may create, and allowance says how many servers it may have and has. Requires project:read.
name: get_project_server
title: Read the project's server
